newsitem.title: USA: Excel Corp says reducing hog slaughter plans.
newsitem.headline: Excel Corp says reducing hog slaughter plans.

text.p: Cargill Inc unit Excel Corp Thursday said it was reducing operating hours at its pork slaughter and processing plants, but officials would not elaborate on how many plants were affected or for how long.
Excel operates hog plants in Ottumwa, Iowa, Beardstown, Ill., and Marshall, Mo.
IBP Inc near midday Thursday announced it was cutting back production at virtually all its seven pork plants this week and next .
IBP estimated it would process 33,000 fewer hogs this week and 59,000 to 60,000 fewer hogs next.
Slaughter cutbacks were spurred by tight hog supplies this week which drove cash prices up and eroded packer operating margins, market sources said.
Interior Iowa/southern Minnesota hog prices Thursday had a top of $56.00 per cwt, USDA said. The top price was up $1.50 from Friday.

Farmland Industries Inc was reviewing next week's operating schedules but had yet to make a decision on possible cutbacks, according to an industry source. Officials from Farmland and other port companies were unavailable for comment.
